title: Quasi-coherent affine module germs are localization maps
statement: Let L be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], N a quasi-coherent O_L-module [pqf-def-coherent], V an affine open, and y a point of V. Put R=O_L(V), p=hV.primeIdealOf(y), and regard N_y [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] as an R-module through the ring germ R → O_{L,y}. There exists an R-linear map f:N(V) → N_y which agrees pointwise with the module germ map and is a localization at R minus p [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. No Noetherian or finiteness assumption is required. The pointwise condition determines f uniquely.

source.place: Tag 01IB, Lemma 26.7.5; Tag 01HV, Lemma 26.5.4 (2), (6), (7); restriction along the affine chart

proof.text: Define the linear map f to be the actual germ, using PresheafOfModules.germ_smul for its scalar law. The pointwise condition is reflexive and determines f uniquely. Identify allowed denominators using primeIdealOf, fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen, and fromSpec_primeIdealOf.
The stalk ring is localization at the point prime. Every allowed denominator therefore has a unit germ; multiplication by a unit is bijective on the module stalk.

Represent a stalk element by a germ and shrink to a basic open inside its neighbourhood and V. exists_map_eq_pow_smul_of_isAffineOpen extends a power multiple to V, giving the fraction-surjectivity axiom. For equal germs, shrink their equality to a basic open; exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isAffineOpen kills the difference by a power, giving the equality axiom. Thus f satisfies all three IsLocalizedModule axioms.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01IA and 01HV, basic-open denominator proof adapted from the private quasicoherent_affine_stalk_germ_localization in FiniteTypeModuleSupportClosed.lean; uses the proved upstream affine basic-open extension and torsion lemmas.

IsLocalizedModule, of_linearEquiv, of_linearEquiv_right, eq_iff_exists and localization universal property tools. No theorem for ambient affine module germs.

Mathlib tilde.toStalk has a localization instance; no ambient affine germ version. No matching blueprint node. Existing affine-free realization is restricted to free modules and does not state this localization property.

lean.statement:
theorem isLocalizedModule_affine_germ
    {L : Scheme.{u}} (N : L.Modules) (hqc : N.IsQuasicoherent)
    (V : L.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (y : V) :
    letI : Module (L.presheaf.obj (op V))
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y) :=
      Module.compHom _ (L.presheaf.germ V y y.2).hom
    ∃ f : N.val.obj (op V) →ₗ[L.presheaf.obj (op V)]
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y),
      (∀ m, f m = N.presheaf.germ V y y.2 m) ∧
      IsLocalizedModule (hV.primeIdealOf y).asIdeal.primeCompl f
